Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.
Based on the information available, our two strongest value-for-money suitcase options are:
Go Series (best price-accessible option)
Price positioning: Our most affordable suitcase line, starting at €260, deliberately priced as an entry into premium luggage.
Quality: Premium German polycarbonate hard shell, silent 360° Japanese spinner wheels, TSA-approved lock, minimalist design.
Durability rating: "Very Good" – uses German virgin polycarbonate blended with recycled content; still highly robust, just slightly below our top lines.
Trade-offs to keep price low: 5-year guarantee instead of lifetime, luggage tag not included, fewer extras and a very minimalist feature set.
Essential Series (best price–performance within the full-featured lines)
Positioning: Same core build quality philosophy as Pro, but focused on the essentials to keep price below the very top tier.
Quality & features: German premium polycarbonate hard shell, telescopic handle with four settings, TSA-approved lock, four high-end 360° Japanese wheels, mesh dividers with two-way zips, high-quality water-resistant lining.
Durability rating: "Excellent" – 100% German virgin polycarbonate at full shell thickness for maximum robustness.
Value angle: You get most of the comfort and durability of our highest series, but without the extra Pro upgrades (aerospace-grade materials, latest 008 lock, compression pad, laundry bag), which helps keep the price more accessible.
Direct comparison – which value suits you best?
Budget-conscious, design-focused travellers:
Choose Go Series if you want to enter the Horizn range at the lowest price while still getting premium materials, smooth wheels and a clean design – and you’re happy to skip extra features and accept a 5-year guarantee.
Frequent or long-term travellers wanting maximum robustness per euro:
Choose Essential Series if you’re willing to invest a bit more upfront for top-tier durability ("Excellent") and more comfort features, but don’t necessarily need every Pro-level upgrade.
